description: Source code for PythonArrowOutput trait and related classes implementing Arrow data processing in Spark's Python execution module.

classes.name: ArrowOutputProcessor
classes.description: Interface for processing Arrow stream data into columnar batches.

classes.name: ArrowOutputProcessorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ArrowOutputProcessor that loads and produces Arrow batches.

classes.name: BaseSliceArrowOutputProcessor
classes.description: Base class for slicing Arrow batches based on byte size or record count.

classes.name: SliceBytesArrowOutputProcessorImpl
classes.description: Slices Arrow batches to fit within a maximum byte size.

classes.name: SliceRecordsArrowOutputProcessorImpl
classes.description: Slices Arrow batches to fit within a maximum record count.

methods.name: deserializeColumnarBatch
methods.description: Converts a ColumnarBatch into the output type; default returns the batch itself.

methods.name: loadBatch
methods.description: Loads the next batch of data from the Arrow stream.

methods.name: produceBatch
methods.description: Produces a ColumnarBatch from the loaded data.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes resources associated with the processor.
